references.text: Previous verse introducing the offering of the firstfruits of the dough (arisot) as a gift to the Lord
Ezekiel repeats the command to give the firstfruits of the dough to the priests, who shall bring blessing over the house
Nehemiah describes how the people committed themselves to bringing the firstfruits of the dough to the priests in the house of the Lord
The basis for the terumah offering (heave offering) as a perpetual statute from the children of Israel
The command not to eat from the new crop until the firstfruits have been given, as a perpetual statute throughout all generations
The firstfruits of grain, wine, and oil shall be given to the priests as their portion
Call to honor the Lord with the firstfruits of all produce
